description: Manually execute seller-side fulfillment of an existing order with a wallet `signedTx`. Returns `{ success, message, code, delegatedId }`. Side effect: broadcasts a market/delegation transaction and may consume balances/resources; not idempotent — each call re-executes. Requires a wallet signature identity. Use only when explicit manual sell is intended; call `tronsave_get_order` first to verify order state before signing.

orderId.description: Target order id (`MObjectId`) to manually fulfill. Should be an order eligible for seller-side manual execution.

paymentAddress.description: Optional payout/payment address override when settlement flow requires it.

signedTx.description: Required wallet-signed transaction payload (TronWeb shape: `{ txID, raw_data, raw_data_hex, signature[] }`). Must come from client-side signing; never fabricate.

raw_data.description: Raw transaction body produced by TronWeb (`raw_data`).

contract.description: At least one TRON contract entry; shape varies by contract type.

signature.description: Wallet signatures over `raw_data_hex`; usually a single hex string (130 chars for 65-byte secp256k1).

txID.description: Transaction hash (64 hex chars, lowercase, no `0x` prefix).

visible.description: Whether addresses inside `raw_data.contract` are base58 (`true`) vs hex (`false`).

name: tronsave_sell_order_manual

anyOf.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

code.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

anyOf.description: On-chain delegate id created by the manual sell when the underlying transaction is confirmed; null until confirmation lands.

delegatedId.description: On-chain delegate id created by the manual sell when the underlying transaction is confirmed; null until confirmation lands.

anyOf.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.

message.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.

anyOf.description: Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`.

success.description: Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`.
